name: plot-and-kin
description: Discover a property's history with cited evidence, reviewable findings, and saved research.
long_description:
Start with an address and a question. Plot & Kin helps you investigate Washington, DC building records, historical maps, and documents you are permitted to use. Review proposed findings before accepting conclusions, then export a dossier with sources, contradictions, and next steps.

Your first local case needs no account, API key, terminal command, or separately installed Node.js. Ask Claude to get started with Plot & Kin or explore a clearly labeled fictional sample. Cases and original documents live outside the extension installation, so updating the extension preserves research. Existing Plot & Kin settings are reused. Optional Astra storage and paid scan interpretation use the separate guided setup. Public-source access requires an internet connection. This extension is a research prototype, with initial coverage limited to selected Washington, DC sources.
